mapper.select: select substr(add_time,1,10) as day, count(distinct id) as users from announce_user group by substr(add_time,1,10)

select substr(paid_at,1,10) as day, count(id) as orders, count(distinct buyer_id) as customers, sum(agreed_price) as amount, round(sum(agreed_price)/count(distinct buyer_id),2) as pcr from announce_order where paid_at is not null and deleted = 0 group by substr(paid_at,1,10)
